set.body:
Hosted Studio run https://github.com/canardlapin/eyes4s/actions/runs/37383450515 on main 001739b8e64a5e3c326b4e4c068ffa09d36c26be passed the repaired SemanticBindingSuite and PlotTableParitySuite on JVM/JS, then exposed separate desktop failures. Full local headless Studio had passed 3592 tests (2 existing ignored), so a local green run does not qualify these hosted races.

Linux: FigureComposerFxSuite template-change focus assertion (line286) saw Figure rather than Panel C, Density maps; A11yRenderSuite compare-t3 (line175) saw two PARENT Tab stops named Plot, nothing drawn yet. Distinguish owner-thread publication races from actual focus/accessibility defects; retain exact assertions and wait for meaningful observable readiness rather than adding sleeps or weakening names.

macOS functional: StudioLogSuite rotation/cap test (line77) enumerated an archive file that Logback's asynchronous pruner deleted before Files.size. Catch only NoSuchFileException for deleted files, close directory streams, preserve existing cap/roll-size bounds and other I/O failures.

Acceptance: bounded fixes with focused failure evidence; affected suites and full headless Studio/style/boundaries pass; hosted Linux and macOS Studio jobs pass on the exact new SHA. No visible tests on the user's desktop. Do not hide failures by skipping suites or widening timeouts/tolerances. Public library code and build are unchanged by the initial repair; retain its successful exact-source library/consumer evidence while checking all affected desktop behavior.
set.title: Resolve hosted Studio desktop failures after picking repair
